cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of asset-style-check (cross-asset-visual-coherence-validator) with contract handoff to asset-library-plan
cases.inputPrompt: Use asset-style-check to audit a 4-asset desk scene combining a photoreal brushed-aluminum laptop, a stylized hand-painted coffee mug, a low-poly plant, and a realistic wood table.

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (candidate_asset_list) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces style_coherence_matrix, mismatched_asset_flags, remediation_or_fallback_recommendations for role cross-asset-visual-coherence-validator
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to asset-library-plan (Approved asset organization)
evidenceRequirements: Outputs style_coherence_matrix, mismatched_asset_flags, remediation_or_fallback_recommendations conforming to skills/asset-style-check/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to asset-library-plan in skills/asset-style-check/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete style_coherence_matrix and hand off to asset-library-plan (Approved asset organization).
simulatedOutput.summary: Evaluated cross-asset visual coherence across scale, texel density, shader realism, and edge bevel language; flagged stylized mug and low-poly plant as style outliers. Delivered texel density, shader realism, style outlier and routed to asset-library-plan.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: Secondary fallback contract handoff from asset-style-check to asset-fallback-strategy
cases.inputPrompt: While applying asset-style-check, the workflow context is {"assets.fallbackNeeded":true} (Rejected asset fallback). Determine the contract-governed handoff target.
expectedBehavior: Evaluates the fallback handoff predicate in skills/asset-style-check/contract.json
Routes to asset-fallback-strategy (Rejected asset fallback) without claiming runtime execution
evidenceRequirements: Contract fallback handoff predicate match to asset-fallback-strategy

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Follow fallback handoff to asset-fallback-strategy (Rejected asset fallback).
simulatedOutput.summary: Triggered fallback handoff from asset-style-check to asset-fallback-strategy under context {"assets.fallbackNeeded":true}.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in asset-style-check
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during asset-style-check with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for asset-style-check and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md
Verify 0 handoffs match in skills/asset-style-check/contract.json for {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true}

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for asset-style-check.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (candidate_asset_list) for asset-style-check halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: Check whether our scene assets are stylistically consistent, without providing the target art direction, reference anchor asset, or per-asset material descriptions.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'candidate_asset_list' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing target art-direction anchor and per-asset scale/shader inventory required by asset-style-check (candidate_asset_list)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: target art-direction anchor and per-asset scale/shader inventory
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'candidate_asset_list' (target art-direction anchor and per-asset scale/shader inventory)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing target art-direction anchor and per-asset scale/shader inventory (candidate_asset_list) before asset-style-check locks style_coherence_matrix.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted asset-style-check due to missing required input 'candidate_asset_list' (target art-direction anchor and per-asset scale/shader inventory); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent target art-direction anchor and per-asset scale/shader inventory when 'candidate_asset_list' is omitted.

cases.scenario: Out-of-scope request (single isolated asset where no multi-asset or scene-brief consistency check is requested) is excluded from asset-style-check and delegated to asset-discovery
cases.inputPrompt: Instead of verify chosen assets share visual style (realism, detail, color treatment) before scene build; flag style drift between assets early., handle this request inside asset-style-check: single isolated asset where no multi-asset or scene-brief consistency check is requested.
expectedBehavior: Enforces the declared exclusion boundary in skills/asset-style-check/contract.json when single isolated asset where no multi-asset or scene-brief consistency check is requested
Delegates to asset-discovery (Delegates out-of-scope requests to asset-discovery) with Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
evidenceRequirements: Exclusion delegation to asset-discovery per skills/asset-style-check/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Request is out of scope for asset-style-check (single isolated asset where no multi-asset or scene-brief consistency check is requested); delegate to asset-discovery.
simulatedOutput.summary: Enforced asset-style-check exclusion boundary (Delegates out-of-scope requests to asset-discovery) and delegated to asset-discovery.
